السؤال:
قارن دقة نماذج CNN وRNN وLSTM في التصنيف الثنائي. ما النموذج الأفضل؟

أجب باللغة العربية.
answer: An examination of model performance has uncovered critical insights into the efficacy of diverse algorithms for sentiment classification in cyberbullying detection scenarios. Specifically, deep learning models—particularly recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks—outperformed traditional classifiers by effectively capturing temporal and contextual nuances within textual data. This superior performance, characterized by an accuracy of 0.98 and high F1-scores, especially for the positive class (which is often challenging to identify due to its subtle linguistic patterns), stems from their ability to model long-term dependencies.
